FNT     EQU     #8800               
        ORG     #9000
FNT4    INCBIN "fnt26",#800

        ORG #8000
        LD L,#80 ;#20
        LD DE,FNT
        LD C,128 ;#E0
CCC     LD H,'FNT4
        LD B,5
ddd     LD A,(HL)
        LD (DE),A
        INC H,DE
        DJNZ ddd
        INC L
        DEC C
        JR NZ,CCC
        RET
